Players Committee card image of [[Vigo (V)]] (original printing), game text: “Deploys -1 to Coruscant. While present with Xizor, forfeit +2 and opponent's spies may not deploy to same non-battleground site. Once per game, may use 1 Force to deploy a non-war room battleground planet site (or system) not already on table from Reserve Deck; reshuffle.”

Source: <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual0-Dark/large/vigo.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable image repository, version of commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/022435b7929e4de26dafbcb1de2ec1d6d04d2153 022435b] (8 July 2018). The PC serves its card images from this repository at res.starwarsccg.org; this is an earlier version of that file.

Edits: none. The repository's bytes are uploaded unchanged.
